description: Defines data structures, enums, and inline functions related to DCI (Downlink Control Information) formats and configurations for 5G NR scheduling, including DL and UL RNTI configurations and CCE position.

classes.name: cce_position
classes.description: Represents the position of a CCE (Control Channel Element) with start index and aggregation level.

classes.name: dci_dl_info
classes.description: Contains information about a downlink DCI message, including RNTI configuration type and associated union data.

classes.name: dci_ul_info
classes.description: Contains information about an uplink DCI message, including RNTI configuration type and associated union data.

methods.name: get_dci_format
methods.description: Retrieves the DCI format based on RNTI configuration type for DL or UL.

methods.name: dci_dl_rnti_config_rnti_type
methods.description: Returns a string describing the RNTI type for DL RNTI configuration.

methods.name: dci_dl_rnti_config_format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the DCI format for a given DL RNTI configuration type.

methods.name: dci_ul_rnti_config_rnti_type
methods.description: Returns a string describing the RNTI type for UL RNTI configuration.

methods.name: dci_ul_rnti_config_format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the DCI format for a given UL RNTI configuration type.
